verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a quick-start that pulls and starts a Docker image with a single command. It also offers pip, uv, and Kubernetes installs, and claims "zero to your first AI conversation in under five minutes." Community notes about very large Docker images are a caveat on install weight, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: the literal install command is not quoted in the evidence, and no independent hands-on report confirms the minutes-to-working-chat claim.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes
